title: Mujhe Kehte Hain Abbas

HAWA ROUK LOON SAARI

MUJHE KEHTE HAIN ABBAS(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Cun at saldi Farat usta alinin qazab oglu
Salib val vala afaqa o ali nasab oglu.
Cakib tigi sarar bar dusub larzaya kuffar.
Dayib birbira asrar ce tipo ce alamdar
Yetib ta safi adaya abalfazli vafadar
O sar cesmayi isar acib nitqi goharbar.
Buyurdu o zaman gus edin ey lesgari xunxaru cafakaru sitamkar,
manam Hazrat Abbas(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Manam sahibi sovlat
Manam siri sucaat
Manam madani qeyrat
Manam manbayi ismat
Manam Hazrate Abbas(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Manam mehri nubuvvat
Manam babi karamat
Manam kani fasahat va balagat va karamat
Manam Hazrate Abbas(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
O sirin harakati
Mukarrar hamalati
Sanavu salavati
Tutub dasto falati
Manam Hazrate Abbas(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Alib nahri Farati
Sevindirdi banati
Dedi qalbizi ey qovm
Tutub kinavo vasvas
Manam Hazrate Abbas(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Alamdari dilavar
Sipahdari muzaffar
Kamar bastayi Heydar
O zargami qazabnak
Abalfazli hunarvar
Vafadari Huseyndir
Boyuk mansabi vardir
Sipahdari Huseyndir
<<DIVIDER>>
BARHA SHAIR E JARI
BANA QAHR E JALI
QAZA KAHNE LAGI
HATAY PAHRE SABHI
SOOY NEHAR GAYA
ALAM GAARH DYA
JO MASHKIZA BHARA
SOOY KHEMA CHALA

ABBAS(a.s.)

UDHAR DAR PAY KHARI BAALI SAKINA(s.a.) KI SADA THI

IDHAR TEER LAGA MASHK PAY OR BAH GAYA PANI
KATAY GHAZI(a.s.) KAY SHAANAY
ALAM DAANTO SAY THAAMAY
GERAA GHORAY SAY ABBAS E ALAMDAR(a.s.) ZAMEEN PER
LAGA AANKH MAIN EK TEER LAGA GURZ JABEEN PER
SAKINA(s.a.) SAY HOON SHARMINDA YEHI KEHTA THA JARRAR(a.s.)
CHACHA(a.s.) TERA HAI GHUMKHUAR
MUJHE KEHTE HAIN ABBAS(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sakina(s.a.) o zaman verdi xabar Aali Abaya
Cagirdi hami atfali yigib xeyma saraya
Goturdu balaca allarini samti samaya
Dilin açdi duaya
Edib arz Xudaya
Ravadir axa darya !
Yana itrati Taha
Sola gulsani Zahra(s.a.) !
Eda mahsari barpa
Sala lasgara qovga
Dola qanila sahra
Aya zumrayi nas nas
Manam Hazrati Abbas(a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
HUWA QATAL JO SAQQA
QAMAR THAAM KAY MOLA(a.s.)
BARHAY JANIB E DARYA
LABOO PER THA YEH NOHA
